title: The Snow Blind
text: The white glare off the snow is blinding, a light that stabs the eyes even through shut lids. The Scions walk with eyes half shut, roped together, stumbling. Somewhere in the white, something moves alongside the rope.

options.label: Stay roped and keep on, and whatever walks beside you, do not let go.

outcomes.text: Slow, and safe, and the thing in the white keeps pace the whole way.

options.label: The steadiest leads with eyes shut, by feel, so the rest may follow.

outcomes.text: Through the glare, and out, and nobody let go.
Over a lip of ice, and the rope is all that holds them.

options.label: Wait for cloud, and spare your eyes.

outcomes.text: The cloud brings snow, and things in it.
